name: Xperia XZ Premium

images.credit: Deoma12, CC BY-SA 4.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Body.Dimensions: 156 mm H, 77 mm W, 7.9 mm D

Platform.CPU: Octa-core (quad 2.45 GHz + quad 1.9 GHz) 64-bit Kryo 280 processor

Memory.Card slot: microSDXC; expandable up to 512 GB (hybrid slot for G8142)

Display.Display: 5.46 in 4K HDR IPS LCD (3840 x 2160 px), TRILUMINOS Display for mobile with X-Reality for mobile, Dynamic Contrast Enhancement, sRGB 138%, 806 ppi

Cameras.Rear camera: 19 MP Motion Eye™ Camera, 1/2.3 memory-stacked IMX400 image sensor, Exmor RS for mobile (1.22μm), BIONZ, RGBC-IR, Laser AF, Predictive Hybrid AF, Predictive Capture, Quick launch, 5x Clear Image Zoom, 25mm Wide Angle G Lens, f/2.0 , 4K (2160p) video recording, 720p 960 fps super slow motion video recording, SteadyShot with Intelligent Active Mode (5-axis stabilization)
Cameras.Front camera: 13 MP 1/3.06 Exmor RS for mobile sensor, with Quick launch and 22mm Wide Angle Lens and f/2.0 aperture, autofocus

Connectivity.Connectivity: Wi-Fi, DLNA, GPS/GLONASS/BeiDou/Galileo, Bluetooth 5 with aptX and LE , USB 3.1 (Type-C port, USB charging, Quick Charge 3.0), 1seg (G8188 and SO-04J models only), Osaifu-Keitai (G8188 and SO-04J models only)
